subject: Brains, Bodies, Benchmark - Physical AI Panel in SF
text:
Hi [NAME],

The event will take place from 5:30pm on Thursday 29th Jan at Weights & Biases's office in SF, with panelists from leading robotics teams, e.g. 1X and Dyna Robotics and more, followed by an informal networking session after.

Full details on the panel here - let me know if I can help you skip the waitlist?

subject: Jing - ML Ops
text:
Hi [NAME], 

        We recently started working with Entrust/Onfido on their ML infra for risk decisioning, and I thought it might be relevant to [COMPANY]'s real-time fraud models. 

        A challenge I hear often from fraud/IDV leaders - closing the loop between model predictions, failure modes, and the data that improves the next training cycle. 

        Encord helps teams streamline the feedback loop with curated data workflows, labeling, QA/QC, and model eval - so you can quickly see where models fail and feed the most useful cases back into training. 

        Is improving model accuracy and iteration on your radar for [YEAR]? If so, would you have 20 min Tue - Thu for a quick chat?

subject: reduce false positives in fraud models
text:
Hi 
      [NAME], 

      I've been chatting with a few ML leaders working on fraud models, and the same thing keeps coming up - how to tighten the feedback loop without driving false positives through the roof. 

      It almost always comes back to data: surfacing edge cases faster and topping up training data where the model breaks, without slowing the team down. Teams like VIDA, Onfido, and Veriff have been using Encord to do exactly that and have seen solid gains in accuracy without sacrificing iteration speed. 

      Curious if this sounds familiar on your side at [COMPANY]. If useful, I'd love to grab 20 mins to swap notes and compare approaches.
